_comment: Purchasable product records, keyed by catalogue slug (slugify of the agent name on /agents). name and sku are what Stripe, the success page and invoices show. A slug with no record here, or with saleApproved=false, blocks LIVE-mode checkout (default-deny); only saleApproved=true opens live sales. Test-mode keys are unaffected, so enabling a test checkout can never start real sales of an unapproved release. release.package is the object name under agents/<slug>/ in private storage (Vercel Private Blob, or R2) that a buyer downloads; release.sha256 must equal the hash of that exact uploaded file (null = not yet published, the success page then omits it). aliases: retired slugs that must keep resolving to this product (old checkout links, Stripe metadata, KV entitlements and certificates written before a rename).
